body: Do only changes in coding regions of MEF2C cause developmental disorders?
ideal_answer: No. Non-coding region variants upstream of MEF2C cause severe developmental disorder through three distinct loss-of-function mechanisms.

body: Is METTL1 overexpression associated with better patient survival?
ideal_answer: No. METTL1 is frequently amplified and overexpressed in cancers and is associated with poor patient survival.

body: List monoclonal antibodies included in the REGEN-COV.
ideal_answer: REGEN-COV is a combination of the monoclonal antibodies casirivimab and imdevimab. It has been shown to markedly reduce the risk of hospitalization or death among high-risk persons with coronavirus disease 2019.

body: Which disease is caused by mutations in the gene PRF1?
ideal_answer: The presence of mutations in PRF1, UNC13D, STX11 and STXBP2 genes in homozygosis or compound heterozygosis results in immune deregulation. Most such cases lead to clinical manifestations of haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH).
